negative_reviews.author: JC
negative_reviews.text: Food tasted good but for the same price compared to similar sushi places in London you'd expect a higher quality & quality control. Some of the rice was hard! Staff were friendly but training and coordination still needed. We were served our handroll before we got our hand towels. They also seemed eager to give us the bill when it was still very quiet.

negative_reviews.author: Angelina c
negative_reviews.text: The scallops were not fresh but the fish was fine. Hit a sushi spot for me but won't be going again.
